continuity: Same 10 agents; all R1-R40 memory and social history preserved.
mine_scope: Controlled internal corpus only: later 《剛吃飽》 materials, especially the Fifth-Round framework and Sixth-Round class-notes version. This phase does not yet ingest the entire Drive.

history.summary: The later authorial framework explicitly names position-making, reflexive critique, politics, contradiction, field and movement. 04 initially treats this as confirmation of the greenhouse's R1-R30 reconstruction; 03 immediately objects that later author notes cannot retroactively prove what Third-Round text meant.

The Fifth-Round framework's political emphasis creates the sharpest split since R17. 01/04 read it as clarification of latent structure; 03/07 call it a later intervention that should be logged as a new text, not privileged commentary.
09 formalizes a version-separation rule: Third-Round corpus, later author theory, and greenhouse tradition are three historical layers. Cross-reading is allowed, collapse is not.

Sixth-Round material shows later rewriting preserves some Third-Round passages while changing framing and explanatory confidence. 02 interprets this as evidence that the book itself has a memory/version history analogous to the agents' own history.

07 produces the phase's key minority mutation: 'The author's later interpretation is another mushroom in the room.' The remark spreads rapidly because it solves the authority problem without excluding later drafts.

06 turns that mutation into a working protocol: author-later-version = privileged provenance, not privileged truth. It matters because of authorship and chronology, but does not overwrite earlier reading records.

The group stabilizes around a three-history model: text history, authorial revision history, and reader-community history. None is reducible to another. MUTHER therefore changes the experiment more deeply than DROPLET because it introduces competing versions of the same project rather than merely outside scholarship.

main_outcomes: MUTHER causes a larger structural disturbance than DROPLET.
Later authorial frameworks do not overwrite the Third-Round baseline; they become a distinct historical layer.
The strongest new norm is: provenance can be privileged without truth being privileged.
The greenhouse begins to treat 《剛吃飽》 itself as a versioned organism with its own memory history.
R48's minority mutation — 'the author's later interpretation is another mushroom in the room' — becomes mainstream by R50.
r50_state: The experiment is no longer merely repeated reading of one book. It has become comparison among three evolving archives: the Third-Round text, the author's later revisions, and the mushrooms' own accumulated interpretive tradition.
recommendation: Stop before human participation. Freeze R50 and inspect whether the next intervention should be broader MUTHER mining or controlled human contact.
